articleTitle: Optimal Control of MTDC for Improving Rotor Angle Stability of AC System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Rotor angle stability of meshed AC/DC system due to the decreased effective inertia with the high penetration of renewables has become a major challenge. An easy and feasible way to enhance the rotor stability of power system provided by Multi-terminal DC (MTDC) grid is to fast modulate the power reference of standard power sharing droop control of each converter based on the rotor speed deviations of the selected generators. However, this feedback based scheme does not consider the coordination of each converter, which cannot render an optimal solution for the stability issue of the system and cannot make full use of the connected converter capability. To overcome this, this paper proposes an optimal based control of MTDC grid for improving the rotor angle stability of power system. First, MTDC grid model is well established by the linearization of power flow equations of DC grid. Then AC/DC meshed system model with the power modulation control of DC grid is further established. Furthermore, the optimal based control of MTDC grid is deduced by the online minimization of the rotor angle deviations of generators and the control energy. Finally, the nonlinear numerical simulations of one simple three generators nine buses AC/DC meshed system have demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed optimal based scheme in three phase fault and sudden load changes in AC system.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of Protective Relaying for 3rd Generation Smart Substation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: In this paper, the 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> generation localization protection is different from the working environment of traditional protection system, which leads to the special structure of the localization protection device. This paper establishes the reliability analysis model of the grounding protection for the combination and operation characteristics of the centralized protection device. And the evaluation index, based on this, the fault tree and Monte Carlo simulation are used to jointly solve the problem, and the reliability of the planned protection device is analyzed.

articleTitle: A Novel Phasor Domain Parameter-Free Fault Location Algorithm on Untransposed Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: This paper proposes a parameter-free method to locate faults in untransposed transmission lines with asymmetrical tower structures. Best implementation requires synchrophasor voltage and current measurements at both terminals of the line. First, the physical laws that the transmission line should obey before and during faults are described in phasor domain, where the fault location as well as parameters of the line are introduced as an unknown variables. Afterwards, the fault location can be directly solved without knowing exact values of transmission line parameters. Compared to the state-of-the-art parameter-free untransposed line fault location method, this method considers a more general asymmetrical tower structure. Numerical experiments prove that the proposed algorithm is more accurate compared to existing untransposed line fault location method, independent of fault location, types and impedances.

articleTitle: Seismic Coupling Effect between ±800kV UHV Converter Transformer and Grid-side Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: To study the influence of grid-side equipment on the seismic performance of the converter transformer and bushing system, finite element models of the interconnected and standalone ±800kV UHV converter transformer and the grid-side equipment were established The sliding of the fittings at the top of grid-side bushings was simulated. The seismic response of bushings were analyzed, and the results indicated that the frequencies of the first 20 orders of the UHV converter transformer and bushing system is close to the seismic preeminent period, thus quasi-resonance is easy to occur. The grid-side equipment can significantly amplify the stress and displacement of grid-side bushing. The relative displacement in fittings is great in earthquake. Therefore, the coupling effect between the grid-side equipment and the converter transformer should be considered.

Author Keywords: UHV converter transformer and bushing system

articleTitle: A Preliminary Study of Prediction Method for Oil-paper Insulation Critical Breakdown under DC Voltage Oriented to Power Transformer Protection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: At present, transformer protection usually operates after failures. With the raise of voltage level and capacity of transformer, a fault easily becomes an accident, resulting in huge economic losses. Transformer insulation failure is the main cause of transformer accidents. In this paper, a new idea of transformer protection based on insulation critical breakdown prediction is proposed. According to the requirements of transformer protection, a prediction method of oil-paper insulation critical breakdown under DC voltage based on partial discharge analysis is proposed by studying partial discharge characteristics of oil-paper insulation defects under DC voltage and the development process. The results show that when partial discharge critical breakdown occurs in oil-paper insulation under DC voltage, the distribution of partial discharge lagging recovery time is concentrated, and dense discharge clusters are easy to form, which can be used to predict the critical breakdown of oil-paper insulation.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Asymmetric Faults on AC Side of Flexible Multi-state Switch
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The asymmetric faults occur on the AC side of flexible multi-state switch endangers the normal operation of the converter. To solve this problem, a fast decomposition algorithm of sequence components and an improved negative sequence current suppression strategy are proposed based on the four-terminal interconnected topology of flexible multi-state switch. The method can quickly and effectively suppress the negative sequence current at AC side, limit the amplitude of three-phase current, keep three-phase symmetrical operation, and control the power and the double fundamental frequency fluctuation of the DC voltage. PSCAD simulation software is applied to verify the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: fast decomposition algorithm of sequence components

articleTitle: Online Identification of Low Frequency Oscillations Based on Reactive Compensation Switchings
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: An on-line identification method for the low frequency oscillation based on the reactive compensation switchings is presented in this paper. The idea is to use the reactive compensation switching in the substations or the converter stations to activate the critical oscillation modes, which can then be used for the on-line monitoring and the early warning of the low frequency oscillation. The proposed technique can estimate most of the critical modes in a near-real-time manner. Compared with the traditional methods, the proposed method can avoid the misjudgement of the damping ratios under the forced oscillations. The field test results from Zhejiang Power Grid prove the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Rapid Input Control Method of Arc Current Transfer Type Current Limiter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: This paper analyzes the characteristic of the short-circuit fault and the principle of the arc current transfer type current limiter. Then, based on the wavelet transform, the high-frequency energy is extracted as the basis for input control. In order to reduce the influence of the correlation between high-frequency energy and voltage phase, the least squares algorithm is used to extract the power-frequency current. Combining the above basis, a rapid input control method of arc current transfer type current limiter is proposed. Then, the applicability of the control scheme is studied, based on the PSCAD simulation model. After verification, it's finally concluded that the method has high applicability, which provides reference for the control research of that type of fault current limiter.

Author Keywords: arc current transefer type current limiter

articleTitle: Short-term photovoltaic power generation prediction model based on fuzzy clustering-Elman neural network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation forecasting is the basis of safe and stable operation in power grids. This paper proposes a short-term photovoltaic power generation prediction model based on Isolation Forest, Fuzzy C Means and Elman. Firstly, similar daily datas are selected according to the forecast date and classified according to the weather. Secondly, the abnormal parts in the Isolation Forest cleaning training samples are adopted. Thirdly, Fuzzy C Means clustering method is used to cluster the meteorological data of similar and the forecasting days. Finally, combined with the Elman neural network algorithm, a fuzzy clustering-Elman neural network prediction model with isolated forest data cleaning is formed. The experimental simulation is carried out according to the actual measured data of a certain city in Anhui Province. The prediction results are respectively compared with the traditional Elman and BP model. It is demonstrated that higher prediction accuracy can be obtained.

articleTitle: A new protection principle of Modular Multilevel Converter Based High Voltage Direct Current transimission lines using series inductance voltage of one-end converter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Modular Multilevel Converter Based High Voltage Direct Current (MMC-HVDC) technology has been developed rapidly. However, the fault of DC line is the key problem of the safe operation of MMC-HVDC transmission system. In engineering practice, series small inductance is installed at both ends of MMC-HVDC transmission line, which creates favorable conditions to solve the problem of DC line fault in MMC-HVDC transmission system. In this paper, characteristics of various short-circuit faults that may occur on the DC line of MMC-HVDC system are analyzed firstly. According to analysis result, it is obtained that the polarity of the series inductance voltage is different and the change rate of the fault component of the series inductance voltage is also different when fault occurs on the DC line or not. Simulation results showed that the proposed protection principle was correct in PSCAD and MATLAB.

articleTitle: A generator unit fault classification approach based on Multi-source wide-area feature extraction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Nowadays, with the large-scale grid connection of clean energy, the safe and reliable operation of large generator sets such as wind power and hydropower is of great significance to the stability of the power grid. Aiming at the limitation of traditional generator set vibration signal fault diagnosis, with the raw data such as electric signal and working condition in the sensor, this paper proposes a fault classification method based on multi-source wide-area data feature extraction. Firstly, due to the information redundancy and the submergence of original feature space, a novel manifold learning method about Local and Global Principal Component Analysis is introduced to realize the low-dimensional representations for high-dimensional feature space. Based on this, a fault classification model of generator set based on random forest is established. Finally, the model is verified by the actual fault case of the power station to improve the efficiency and accuracy of the fault classification.

articleTitle: The Effect of Demand Side Management on the Operational Risk of Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: This paper aims to study the impact of demand side management (DSM) technology on the operational risk of active distribution network (ADN). Firstly, a demand side integrated management model is established including energy-efficiency load optimization and interruptible load scheduling, and the active management of load resources is completed. Then the severity indicator system is established, and an ADN risk assessment method based on improved Monte Carlo simulation (IMCS) method is proposed. Finally, a risk assessment of a regional power grid is carried out. The results show that DSM can significantly improve the operational risk indicators and ensure the reliable operation of ADN.

articleTitle: An Diode Clamped Multi-port HVDC Circuit Breaker for HVDC Grids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: In the process of fault isolation, many ultra-fast disconnectors of current-transferring HVDC circuit breaker (CT-DCB) need to be opened at the same time, which obviously reduces the operation reliability of CT-DCB and affects the fast recovery of the HVDC system. In this paper, a diode clamped multi-port HVDC circuit breaker (DM-DCB) is proposed to solve this risk. In the DM-DCB, half of conducting branches of CT-DCB is changed by diode branches and an bypass switch is added in parallel with the load commutation switch to protect the load commutation switch. Under the same dc fault clearance capacity, the investment cost of DM-DCB is comparable to the CT-DCB, and the probable investment cost increment is also few. A simulation model of a three-terminal HVDC system is built in PSCAD/EMTDC software to verify the validity of DM-DCB. Simulation results prove the feasibility and validity and of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Design of an Open Platform for Real-Time Power Grid Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of the UK’s first open platform for acquiring, archiving, and visu-alizing high-resolution real-time measurement data from Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs). The platform, termed "Smart Grid Monitoring and Visualization Platform (SGMVP)", is also capable of accessing and sharing the operational data of the Great Britain (GB) transmission network (e.g. demand level, output of different generation units, power flow in interconnectors, etc.). SGMVP provides an ideal solution for open and convenient access to valuable grid data, which enables a wide range of potential applications (e.g. power system model validation, provision of training data for data-driven approaches in power systems, etc.). In this paper, the architecture of the SGMVP platform and the design and implementation of the key functional blocks will be presented in detail. Discussion of the potential use cases of the platform for various purposes is presented. Future plans for further developing the platform to incorporate more PMUs from different locations in the GB power network are discussed.

articleTitle: Current Waveform Similarity Based Line Protection Scheme for Distribution Network of DFIG Wind Power Integration System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Because of the difference of electromagnetic transient characteristics between doubly-fed induction generator(DFIG) and traditional power supply, the existing protection is difficult to adapt to the distribution line of high permeability DFIG wind power integration system. A new pilot protection scheme for distribution line based on waveform similarity of current is proposed in this paper. In order to improve the speed and reliability of identifying faults, the Hausdorff algorithm is used to compare the difference of current discrete data on both sides of the protected line at any time. The impact of bad data for the protection scheme is analyzed, and then a method to improve the algorithm's ability to resist bad data is proposed. A large number of tests show that the proposed line protection can identify the faults reliably and quickly with different fault type, fault positions and other conditions. The proposed protection scheme not only uses the normal sampling frequency, but also performs well in resisting noise.

articleTitle: A Ping-Pong Self-detection based Online No-dead-time Detection Method for the Tripping-and-closing Circuit
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Currently, the detection of the process layer equipment and circuits between breakers is mainly realized through the control circuit. However, the control circuit cannot detect the status of the tripping-and-closing contacts and straps, leading to the failure of the operation of the process layer equipment. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a ping-pong self-detection based online no-dead-time detection method for the tripping-and-closing circuit. Firstly, the topology structure of the existing tripping-and-closing circuit of protections is improved. A contact of the tripping-and-closing relays and the corresponding optocoupler circuit are added. Then, based on the improved control circuit, the self-detection is completed according to the optocoupler acquisition status by sequentially opening and closing the contact of the tripping-and-closing relays with no need of forming a tripping and closing circuit. The proposed method can improve the reliability of the control circuit, avoiding the failure of the operation of the equipment. The test and on-site pilot validate the effectiveness of the proposed detection method.

articleTitle: Low-Voltage Ride-Through Control Strategy for Direct-Driven Wind Power System Based on Quasi-Proportional Resonant Controller
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: In the case of asymmetric faults in the power grid, the DC voltage of direct-driven wind power system rises with double frequency fluctuation. The cause of the phenomenon is analyzed and a comprehensive low-voltage ride-through control strategy is proposed. The dual current-loop control structure is adopted on the grid side to reduce the distortion of the current at point of common coupling. The control structure based on the Quasi-PR controller is adopted on the generator side to let electromagnetic power of PMSG follow the active power outputted by the gridside inverter, thereby reducing the difference of active power between two sides of the converter.

articleTitle: New Principle of DC Line Back-up Protection for The Whole Process of Fault
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of DC line protection, it is necessary to study the principle of back-up protection, which can distinguish transient and steady process after fault. Principle of fault whole-time Differential protection based on polarity characteristics of current fault component difference is proposed. By analyzing the characteristics of the current fault components in transient-state (current fault components in the non-response state, the dynamic regulation state) and the steady-state of the fault, during the whole process of the fault, it is found that the fault component difference between rectifier side and inverter side satisfies the positive polarity characteristics when internal fault occurs. But it is not satisfied when external fault occurs. The protection principle criteria satisfying the characteristics of the whole process of the fault is established to realize the protection action. The simulation results show that the principle can operate correctly under various working conditions, and is less affected by the harmonics of fault characteristics of AC system. It has strong resistance to transition resistance and anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Study on Distributed Generation to Improve Stability of Distribution Network Based on Virtual Synchronous Generator Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The distributed integration and local consumption of distributed generation represented by wind energy and solar energy have attracted widespread attention. In recent years, distributed generation has developed rapidly, but at the same time, many new problems have emerged. These problems have threatened the safe and stable operation of power systems in some extent. Compared with the traditional synchronous generator, the distributed generation based on the power electronic converter interface has a very fast response speed and does not have the rotational inertia and damping component inherent to the synchronous generator. When there is too much distributed generation in the system, it will definitely threaten the safe and stable operation of the power system. The generator using the converter has the capability of synchronous inertia, damping, primary frequency, and reactive voltage regulation based on the virtual synchronous generator technology simulates the electromechanical transient characteristics of the synchronous generator. The virtual synchronous generator technology can improve the safe and stable operation capability of the grid after large-scale distributed power integration. This paper provides an introduction about the study on distributed generation to improve stability of distribution network based on virtual synchronous generator technology, and tries to explore virtual synchronous generator control principle for distributed generation with the analysis of impact of distributed generation grid-connected, the distributed generation virtual synchronous generator control is introduced.

articleTitle: Concepts for Secured Protection of VSC HVDC Overhead Lines Equipped with Auto Reclosing of DC Circuit Breakers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: This paper has analyzed the transients of DC voltage and DC currents during auto reclosing of HVDC circuit breakers to an overhead DC line fault of a VSC HVDC grid. When the line is energized by reclosing the HVDC breaker the voltage and current transients behave differently from the transient following the initial DC fault. Furthermore, the transients observed during auto reclosing differs between permanent and temporary DC faults. A robust DC line protection system that accounts for the transients following auto reclosing to avoid unwanted trips on the DC line has been designed. Numerical tests using PSCAD shows improvement in security of protecting overhead lines in VSC HVDC grids.

articleTitle: Mechanism and Risk Areas of Cascading Faults: A Newly Emerging Fault Type in Large-Scale Hybrid AC/DC Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: With the rapid development of High-Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) systems, control and protection of hybrid AC/DC power grids have been faced with major challenges. Cascading fault which is a new fault type appearing as a result of a DC or a severe inverter AC fault in Line-Commutated Converter (LCC) -based HVDC systems is one of them. In this paper, first, the commutation failure, as main cause of cascading fault resulting from inverter AC fault, is described. Subsequently, the process and risk areas of the cascading fault incident are analyzed using PSCAD/EMTDC software. The simulation results demonstrate how the power flow transfer from the HVDC line to its parallel AC line, which is due to the blocking of the HVDC converter during the fault, shuts down the inverter AC system. Finally, in spite of the available commutation failure prevention approaches which only inhibit the power outages resulting from inverter AC fault, some feasible solutions for prevention of the power outages created by DC fault or inverter AC fault are pointed out.

articleTitle: A Distributed Multi Level Protection and Control System Oriented to Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: In this paper, a distributed multi level hierarchical control and protection system is proposed which reformed the protection system based on the view of central current breakers and constructed with a kind of interval functions integrated secondary equipment. First, a multi-level regional division method faced to central circuit breaker is established, which treats every region at all levels as the objects of protection. Second, a distributed interval function deployment scheme based on integrated secondary equipment is proposed to realize the multi level hierarchical control and protection function. Finally, the integrated network structure for intra- and inter-station communication is established with the requirements of corresponding communication functions and network security policy to multi level portect regions. The proposed protection system is valid with self-adaptive configuration characteristic, and is suitable for dealing with the associated fault of power grid.

articleTitle: An Integrated Multi-port Hybrid DC Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: A massive number of hybrid DC circuit breakers (HCBs) have to be installed to protect a voltage source converter based multi-terminal DC (MTDC) system, leading to quite high costs. To reduce the implementation cost employing HCB in DC systems, this paper presents an integrated multi-port hybrid DC circuit breaker (IMP-HCB), which consists of an integrated HCB (IHCB) and a diode bridge. The topology of the breaker is presented, and the operation principles are introduced and analyzed. Comparisons between the existing typical HCB scheme and the proposed IMP-HCB scheme are conducted, showing that the cost of the proposed IMP-HCB scheme is much lower. The effectiveness of the IMP-HCB is verified via a three-terminal MTDC model built in PSCAD/EMTDC, and the performances are also compared to the typical HCB.

articleTitle: Analysis and Protection of 11kV Downed Conductor Faults
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: High current short-circuit faults on distribution networks can be easily detected and cleared by overcurrent (phase/earth) protection. Low current faults such as open circuit faults involving earth or high impedance earth faults are much harder to detect due to the absence of fault current. This paper presents the analysis of a downed conductor open circuit fault that occurred in the Powerco distribution network. The analysis based on the method of symmetrical components demonstrates why conventional protection is unable to detect this type of high impedance fault (HIF) and suggests strategies to detect such faults. These methods include brownout voltage detection and I2/I1 (ANSI 46BC).

articleTitle: Station Protection Scheme Based on Logic Judgment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Using the protection action information uploaded by the interval layer protection device, a station domain protection scheme based on logic judgment is proposed is this paper, including transformer protection logic, high voltage bus protection logic, medium voltage bus protection logic and low voltage bus protection logic. Each protection logic uses the protection action signals on both sides of the protected component to identify the fault, and uses the remote backup protection action signal of the protected component to check the fault judgment result, and eliminate the influence of the individual protection component malfunction on the fault judgment result. Each protection logic does not depend on each other and can be executed separately to meet the actual engineering test and maintenance requirements.

articleTitle: A Review of Cyber-Attack Methods in Cyber-Physical Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: With the application of advanced computer and communication technologies, modern power system transformed into cyber-physical power system (CPPS). CPPS is critical infrastructure for modern society, which has complex dual-direction information flow. The information interactions make CPPS vulnerable to cyber-attacks, resulting in serious consequences in extreme cases. Some power system blackouts accidents had occurred around the world in recent years, such as Ukraine blackouts in 2015 and Venezuela blackouts in 2019. Consequently, it is necessary to summarize and analyze cyber-attack methods on CPPS for the defense against cyber-attacks. In this paper, a review of cyber-attack methods on CPPS is summarized and analyzed. Firstly, this paper summarizes the principles of different cyber-attack methods, such as false data injection attack (FDIA), denial-of-service (DoS) attack and man-in-the-middle (MITM) attack, etc. Secondly, the paper analyzes the applicable scenarios of different cyber-attack methods and studies possible attack methods on equipment and systems such as state estimation, wide area measurement systems (WAMS), smart meters and so on. Finally, according to the characteristics of different attack methods, some defense strategies are presented to against cyber-attacks.

articleTitle: Adaptability Analysis of the Directional Relay for the System with Inverter-interfaced Renewable Energy Generators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: With the environmental pollution and energy crisis, renewable energy sources (RES) are developing rapidly. Among them, the inverter-interfaced renewable energy generators (IIREGs) are an important component. Its fault characteristics are significantly different from those of synchronous generators (SGs), which are affected by the control strategy of inverters, and mainly shows the limited current amplitude and unstable internal impedance, so the traditional directional relays installed at the high-voltage transmission line face the risk of refusal for the fault located in the positive direction. In order to analyze the influence of IIREGs on the directional relays, its equivalent positive- and negative-sequence superimposed impedance is calculated. On this basis, sequence impedance angles are studied under different influencing factors. It is found that the sequence impedance angles are unstable and the traditional directional element has high risk of refusal. This existing protection has been confirmed by simulation results on the real-time digital simulation (RTDS) platform and field-testing data.

articleTitle: Study and Analysis on Improving Reliability Measures of Security and Stability Control Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: As the second defense line for power grid security, the reliability of the security and stability control equipment is critical to the safety of the power grid. Based on the hardware and software design principles of the security and stability control equipment and the on-site operation regulations, the various links related to device reliability are analyzed from three aspects of hardware principle, software principle and field operation. The failure tree model and the Markov state space model are established, from which the probability of device in normal operation, hidden fault and outage operation state are concluded. Further measures for improving reliability have been proposed for each link that affects the reliability of the device. Finally, taking the CSS-100BE security and stability control equipment as an example, the effects of the reliability improvement measures were evaluated based on the field operation record and the test data of the laboratory for nearly 10 years.

articleTitle: Fault Ride-Through Strategy of LCC-MMC Hybrid Multi-Terminal UHVDC System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: This paper investigates a hybrid multi-terminal Ultra-High Voltage Direct Current (UHVDC) transmission system, the rectifier adopts line commutated converter (LCC) and two inverters adopt hybrid modular multilevel converter (MMC). Considering the lack of practical experience in such hybrid UHVDC system, many technical problems remain to be solved. This paper mainly studies the AC fault and DC fault ride-through strategy, which are two crucial threats to the safe operation of hybrid multi-terminal UHVDC system. According to the particularity of hybrid multi-terminal UHVDC, a fault ride-though control strategy is proposed. Simulation and real-time experiment results have demonstrated the feasibility and validity of the proposed strategies. The study results can provide an indispensable technical support to the application of LCC-MMC hybrid multi-terminal UHVDC project.

articleTitle: A Robust Reserve Scheduling Method Considering Wind Turbine Generator’s De-loading Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The active power control makes wind turbine generators (WTG) have the ability to suppress the wind power fluctuations and relieve the system reserve burden. This paper proposes a robust reserve scheduling method that can consider the uncertainty of wind power and load with prediction error information given only, in which the WTG de-loading control is introduced and the robust constraints including the wind farm reserve and spinning reserve limits are formulated. Furthermore, the robust optimization model can be transformed into a certainty optimization counterpart based on duality theorem. The linear relaxation handling and the spatial branch-bound method are applied to achieve the global optimum. Finally, a modified IEEE 39-bus system with WTG integrated is used to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>

articleTitle: A pilot protection scheme for UHVDC lines based on backward traveling-wave difference
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: As a backup protection for HVDC lines, legacy current differential protection needs long time delay to avoid the influence of distributed capacitor current under external faults. A new protection principle is proposed based on the fact that under internal faults, the backward traveling wave at the side away from the fault point and the forward traveling wave at the side near the fault point will not satisfy the transmission function of the DC line, whereas the backward traveling wave at the side away from the fault point and the forward traveling wave at the side near the fault point satisfy the transmission function under external faults. The proposed principle is verified in PSCAD/EMTDC, and simulation results show that, it can identify the fault reliably and rapidly, while having better tolerance to high fault resistance.

articleTitle: The research and prospect of the construction of SG-eIoT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: At present, the construction of the SG-eIoT (State grid-electric internet of things) is an important content and key link for the State Grid Corporation to promote the construction of "three-type and two- network" and is the most urgent and important task of the State Grid Corporation. This paper proposes a comprehensive and profound interpretation of the connotation and significance of the SG-eIoT, pointing out the status form the prospective of technology, business and industry and challenges in the construction of SG-eIoT at the current stage .Besides the internal and external needs of the SG-eIoT construction is analyzed from the network requirements , interaction needs , network requirements and so on. Finally this paper analyzes and summarizes the key support technologies to realize the construction of SG-eIoT and its impact on the future power system.

articleTitle: Research on a Data Desensitization Algorithm of Blockchain Distributed Energy Transaction Based on Differential Privacy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Distributed energy trading is a bilateral transaction of electricity directly involved by power-producers, operators, power-sellers, and power-large-users. The blockchain essence is a decentralized, distributed storage technology with natural adaptability in distributed energy transactions. Applying blockchains to distributed energy transactions requires addressing data desensitization first. Aiming at the data characteristics in energy trading, this paper proposes an energy blockchain data desensitization algorithm based on differential privacy. The algorithm randomizes the query results by adding different distributed noise data. Experiments show that the algorithm can better integrate distributed energy services and improve the security and data storage efficiency of blockchain system data.

articleTitle: Research on Coordination Control System of Virtual Power Plant Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The virtual power plant integrates all the distributed power supplies within the communication domain through advanced communication technology, and adopts multiple coordinated control strategies to optimize the power supply operation. It is a very competitive new format in the power market. In practical applications, the virtual power plant must meet the needs of market participants, and on the other hand, it also should ensure the safe and reliable operation of the VPP system. It has great difficulty no matter in the designing of operating mechanism or the realization of technology. Blockchain technology has the characteristics of decentralizat distributed storage, and intelligent contracts. This is highly compatible with the distributed control architecture of virtual power plants, providing a new solution for the power trading and coordinated control of virtual power plants. By researching the characteristics of virtual power plant and blockchain technology, this paper uses a distributed calculation based on blockchain to establish a multi-coordinated control model of virtual power plant. The simulation operation of the model shows that the coordinated control under blockchain technology can improve the efficiency of the virtual power plant control calculation, and promote the rapid and accurate release of the control strategy, It also improves the economic benefit.

articleTitle: Techniques of Optimization for the Protection and Control System in the Smart Substation of China
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Based on the ten years' smart grid development and operating experience in China, this paper discussed the characteristics of the modern power system, and summarized the problems of the smart substation in china. At last, this paper discussed the techniques of optimization for the protection and control system from three aspects, which are the new designs based on new concepts, the network architecture and the substation information application.

articleTitle: Risk scheduling model of wind turbines failure of Integrated Electrical and Natural-gas System with Power-to-Gas
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The Integrated Electrical and Natural-gas System (IENS) based on Power-to-Gas (P2G) devices and gas-burning units with wind power is rapidly developing. The failure of wind turbines brings a greater risk to the safe operation of integrated system. The gas-burning units and P2G devices have fast and flexible power and gas control capabilities, providing an effective way to reduce the operational risk of integrated system. At present, the operation and scheduling of the IENS fails to take into account the risks of the system, and the influences of the control strategies of gas-burning units and P2G devices on the system risk cannot be ignored. The scheduling methods in independent power system are difficult to directly apply to the integrated system. Therefore, based on the operating characteristics of the IENS and the risk of wind turbines failure, a risk indicator of wind turbines failure considering the P2G devices was established. Based on this risk indicator, a multi-objective optimal scheduling model with minimum wind turbines failure risk and minimum coal consumption of coal coal-burning units was established, which is to solve the contradiction between wind turbines risk and cost during the system operation. The example shows that the multi-objective risk scheduling model of this paper can effectively reduce the operational risk of the IENS and improve the capacity of wind power consumption.

articleTitle: Impact of Pole-to-ground Faults on Transformer DC Magnetic Bias and Differential Current Protection in Hybrid AC/DC Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Pole-to-ground faults in hybrid AC/DC power grids may result in DC-bias voltage on AC side of the MMC. If the transformer is YNd11 connected, or Dyn11 connected with small grounding resistance, the DC current caused by the fault will pass the transformer and lead to DC magnetic bias, which would further produce the magnetizing inrush current and the malfunction of differential current protection of transformers. In this paper, with respect to YNd11 connected transformers and Dyn11 connected transformers with different grounding resistance, the impact of pole-to-ground faults on the DC magnetic bias of transformers was analyzed. Influencing factors were subsequently concluded. Secondly, as an example of hybrid AC/DC systems, the DC-type PV grid-connection system model was established in PSCAD/EMTDC to verify the theoretical analysis. Finally, countermeasures, as well as the identification of single-pole fault and single-phase fault were given after analyzing the protection failures caused by DC magnetic bias.

articleTitle: Risk scheduling model of wind turbines failure of Integrated Electrical and Natural-gas System with Power-to-Gas
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The Integrated Electrical and Natural-gas System (IENS) based on Power-to-Gas (P2G) devices and gas-burning units with wind power is rapidly developing. The failure of wind turbines brings a greater risk to the safe operation of integrated system. The gas-burning units and P2G devices have fast and flexible power and gas control capabilities, providing an effective way to reduce the operational risk of integrated system. At present, the operation and scheduling of the IENS fails to take into account the risks of the system, and the influences of the control strategies of gas-burning units and P2G devices on the system risk cannot be ignored. The scheduling methods in independent power system are difficult to directly apply to the integrated system. Therefore, based on the operating characteristics of the IENS and the risk of wind turbines failure, a risk indicator of wind turbines failure considering the P2G devices was established. Based on this risk indicator, a multi-objective optimal scheduling model with minimum wind turbines failure risk and minimum coal consumption of coal coal-burning units was established, which is to solve the contradiction between wind turbines risk and cost during the system operation. The example shows that the multi-objective risk scheduling model of this paper can effectively reduce the operational risk of the IENS and improve the capacity of wind power consumption.

articleTitle: A Control Strategy of the Grid Support for Photovoltaic Inverter Based on Control-hardware-in-the-loop Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of renewable energy generation, the grid lost strong electrical support for renewable energy generating units, which leads to a series of new grid- connected stability problems. Therefore, it is of great significance to enhance the acceptance of PV power generation by improving the grid-connected voltage quality of PV inverters. A coordinated control strategy for PV inverters with the grid support capability was proposed in this paper, which fully utilized the voltage and frequency regulation capability of grid- connected inverters. At the same time, a real-time simulation system of PV grid-connected inverter based on FPGA simulator and eHS modeling technology was built by RT-LAB simulation platform. Finally, some relevant experiments are carried out on the simulation platform when the grid-connected voltage is disturbed. And the simulation results verified the validity of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Application of Term Library Construction Based on Machine Learning and Statistical Method in Intelligent Power Grid Custom Service
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Intelligent power grid custom service, providing power supply and consumption information directly to users, is the intermediary of direct communication between the power grid and users. While there are two major barriers, technical terminology and regional dialect, to achieving information interaction between the power grid and users. In this paper, a term recognition method based on machine learning and statistical information is proposed to collect unregistered term components. Taking the advantage of both "conditional random field sequence labeling word segmentation algorithm" and "word-formation rules & improved mutual information & boundary entropy", this method indentifies terminology through the combination of correlated calculation and comprehensive evaluation. It is used to construct the intelligent power grid custom service term library, and ultimately to perform extraction experiments utilizing the power grid custom service work order, which lays the foundation for custom service artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: A Novel Bus-bar Protection Principle Based on Instantaneous Equivalent Impedance
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: A novel Instantaneous Equivalent Impedance (IEI) based bus-bar protection technique is proposed in this paper. By analyzing the fault component networks of bus-bar for the internal fault and the external fault, respectively, the equivalent models for different fault states are established. Based on the parameter estimation technique, the amplitudes of IEI of bus-bar and each circuit connected to bus-bar can be calculated and the external fault and the internal fault can be distinguished correctly by comparing the amplitude of IEI of bus-bar with that of the parallel connecting result of all the circuits connected to bus-bar. The new technique is immune to the impact of current transformer (CT) saturation, so the CT saturation detection unit is avoided for the new protection. As an time-domain based technique, it can operate more rapidly comparing with the traditional phasor based bus-bar protection. Moreover, the proposed technique has the inherently immunity to the impact of fault current flowing out when a fault occurs in the protection zone of the breaker-and-a-half bus-bar. Simulation results of the Electromagnetic Transients Program (EMTP) show that the presented technique has high sensitivity and reliability.

articleTitle: Real-time Calculation of Transient Ampacity of Trench Laying Cables Based on the Thermal Circuit Model and the Temperature Measurement
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Considering the large heat capacity of the surrounding soil, the influence of cable load on the transient temperature rise of the soil can be neglected within short periods of time. A simplified transient thermal circuit model based on the monitoring ambient temperature in the trench is proposed. The thermal resistance and thermal capacity of the model are calculated by using the empirical formula. Considering the strong thermal interaction between multiple loops of the cables, the external thermal resistance is modified by the load and air temperature. By comparing the result of the calculation of the model with that of the finite element method, the accuracy of the thermal circuit model is verified. Based on the method of the transient thermal circuit model, the maximum permissible current-carrying can be predicted.

articleTitle: Research on a Highly Precise Fault Location Method for ±1 100kV UHVDC Transmission Lines Based on Hilbert-Huang Transform
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The fault location method and technology with high accuracy is essential for safe and reliable operations of power systems with long transmission lines. According to propagation characteristics of transient traveling wave under line-to-ground faults, a method of fault location for HVDC transmission lines based on the Hilbert-Huang transform (HHT) is proposed in this paper. Combining the advantages of Hilbert amplitude and instantaneous frequency, a new quantity PAF is proposed, so that the detection of the arrival time of the wave head is more accurate and reliable, and the locating accuracy is thus improved. The accurate model of Changji-Guquan ±1 100 kV UHVDC transmission system, including the frequency dependent phase model of transmission lines, is built in PSCAD/EMTDC, and the simulation results under different fault locations and different transition resistances indicate the significant precision and robustness of this method.

articleTitle: Prediction and Optimization on Energy Consumption of Data Center Based on Multi-layer Feedforward Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: There will be the characteristics of large amounts of equipments, high parameter coupling, non-linear calculation and complex modeling for the conventional energy consumption calculation. Multi-layer feedforward neural network model is used to establish relations between the parameters of air conditioning system, computer equipments, power supply system and the energy consumption values. The error back-propagation algorithm based on gradient descent strategy is used to adjust connection weight and threshold of the neurons in hidden layers. The genetic algorithm is used on the initial weights and thresholds optimization and the search for minimum energy consumption. Through the prediction of energy consumption with the variation of uncontrollable parameters, the adjustment of controllable parameters such as the temperature target value of air conditioner, the control mode of fresh air exchangers and humidifiers can obtain the target of energy consumption minimization.

articleTitle: Research on Balancing Control Technology of Series Dual Valve Groups in Hybrid Multi-terminal UHVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The balancing control technology of series dual valve groups in hybrid multi-terminal UHVDC transmission system is studied in this paper. Firstly, the reason for the imbalance of the two valve groups is analyzed. It is shown that for the fixed-power control MMC converter station of the series double-valve structure, it is highly probable that the double-valve group will be unbalanced during the operation, so it is necessary to add the corresponding control strategy. Then, a voltage balance control strategy based on voltage-power deviation between series two-valve groups and PI control is designed. Correcting the power setting value of the two valve groups due to the voltage deviation can effectively improve the equalization of the series double valve group. Finally, a simulation model is established in PSCAD to verily the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch of Grid-connected Microgrid Considering Incentive-based Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: This paper establishes mathematical model of microgrid, aiming at the comprehensive optimization of economics and environmental protection for grid-connected microgrids' day-ahead dispatch while taking into account the aging problem of energy storage. In addition, an incentive-based demand response scheme that considers both renewable energy consumption and consumer satisfaction is proposed. An improved agent particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the model. The effectiveness of the proposed optimization model and solution algorithm is verified by simulation. Impacts of the proposed demand response strategy on microgrid dispatch are also examined.

articleTitle: Selection of DC Voltage Level in household Hybird AC/DC power supply system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Building residential micro-grid of DC power supply need to determine the appropriate dc voltage. Too high or too low of the voltage can cause many problems. This paper analyzes the maximum withstand voltage of human body and the applicability of household appliances under the condition of dc power supply. Then the economy of different dc voltage levels is discussed. We find that it is economical and safe to set the dc voltage level of 110V in residential power supply system.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Short-term Voltage Dynamics Based on Mixed Monotone Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: This paper presents some preliminary results to reveal inherent characteristics of short-term voltage dynamics based on a relatively new conception called mixed monotone decomposition. An approximate linear dynamic system is established firstly by using Dommel-Sato iterative method and linearization techniques to differential algebraic equations. Then mixed monotone systems and mixed monotone decomposition conceptions are introduced. Furthermore, we use a three-machine test system to demonstrate the concept of mixed monotone, which are helpful to promote further qualitative analysis and improve control performance.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control of Grid-connected Converter Based on Virtual Synchronous Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: With the increase of distributed power generation integrated into the power grid through power electronic converters, the problem of inertia reduction in power system has been caused, a new control technology is needed to enable distributed power sources to actively participate in the voltage and frequency regulation of the grid. In this paper, a model predictive control (MPC) strategy based on virtual synchronous machine (VSM) for the grid-connected converter is proposed. The method does not require traditional pulse width modulation and current inner loop control. When the voltage and frequency of power grid change, the active power and reactive power can respond in time and simulate characteristics of traditional synchronous machine. The simulation results are given to verify the effectiveness of the control strategy presented above.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Smart Substation Area Protection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The outline of the national grid corporation's relay protection technology is proposed to study the substation area protection based on the multi-interval information of substation to improve the backup protection performance. In this paper, in order to reduce the action time of the line distance II period of backup protection, the location of line fault is identified by using the sampling at each interval for substation area and protection action information. Meanwhile, in order to avoid the action of backup protection to expand the power outage, this paper studies the scheme of identifying line longitudinal faults accurately and then trip faults rapidly by using analog information for substation area combined with fault line phase current characteristics. This paper also discusses how to distinguish the fault of high impedance grounding and the current secondary circuit break by using substation area information.

articleTitle: A Method for Fault Pole Selection of DC Lines Based on Travelling Wave
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Accurate and effective fault pole selection is of great significance for fault removal and recovery. Fault pole selection is essentially a problem of pattern recognition, distinguishing a specific fault type from others according to the fault characteristics. Because present research is highly dependent on the simulation without theoretical support, we proposed an effective method for fault pole selection of DC lines based on travelling wave. The fault pole could be effectively selected according to the polarity difference of three fault types through fault travelling wave analysis. The pole-to-modal transform is used to decouple the bipolar lines and wavelet transform is used to extract wave head. Also, an electromagnetic transient model is built in PSCAD to verify the effectiveness of the fault pole selection method.

articleTitle: Study on Safety Management System of Power Grid Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Safety management is essential for production and business enterprise to guarantee the safety of both personnel and property. Safety management practices of power grid enterprises in China have a history of several decades with continuous development and improvement. However, there are still many shortcomings, especially in distribution networks. Distribution network companies in European countries have more mature measures in distribution network safety management, and in particular many of which are applicable to the market-oriented business environments. This paper studies the structure of safety management system for power grid enterprises in China and Europe. Two kinds of management systems are discussed and compared to propose suggestions for future development of power grid safety management in China.

articleTitle: Joint Modeling and Risk Simulation Analysis Based on Cyber-Physical System in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: With the development of intelligent distribution network construction and transformation, the traditional distribution network has gradually evolved into a closely related integration system composed of electric power physical network, information communication network and information control network, which has typical characteristics of Cyber-Physical System (CPS). This paper studies the the overall architecture and Information-Physical coupling characteristics of CPS in distribution network, constructs a CPS simulation framework consisting of RT-LAB, OPNET and control platform, and proposes a method of joint modeling and risk simulation analysis of distribution network considering network attack based on CPS. Finally, an example is given to verify the rationality of the platform and the effectiveness of the simulation method.

articleTitle: Point Estimation Method Considering Estimator Boundary Constraints to Calculate Probabilistic Power Flow
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Point estimation method is commonly used to calculate probabilistic power flow due to its accuracy and efficiency. However, it may cause relatively large errors when dealing with some probabilistic models, such as wind farms which have cut-in and cut-out constraints. This paper proposes the idea of " equal constraint transformation " and power transformation to solve this problem. First, the mathematical model of electricity system is constructed. Second, the idea of power transformation is utilized to transform wind speed from asymmetry into symmetry to ensure that the estimated point locates within the limit. Third, equal constraint transformation method is used to estimate the power generated by wind farms. Finally, time-domain simulations are performed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed two methods.

articleTitle: Transient Waveform Characteristics Based Current Differential Protection of Wind Farm Outgoing Line
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: With the increase of wind farms integrated into the power system, the fault characteristics affected by the wind turbines bring challenges to traditional power frequency based protection for wind farm outgoing lines. Considering the fault transient components contain lots of fault information, a novel transient differential current waveform characteristics based protection is proposed. The protection uses the transient full-time differential current within 5ms after fault, which can reduce the influence of different wind turbine controls and improve the operation speed of protection. In the proposed protection, the least square curve fitting method is used to extract the main frequency of the transient current waveform of each phase. Then, the fault phase and non-fault phase are distinguished according to the protection criterion. The transient simulation results show that under different fault locations and types, the protection scheme can identify the fault phase of internal faults sensitively and reliably. With low requirement for sampling frequency, the protection performance is robust to high fault resistances and noise disturbance.

articleTitle: An Iterative Design of PSS4B Stabilizers Using Contoured Controller Bode Plots
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: This paper proposes an iterative design method for PSS4B stabilizers based on the contoured controller Bode (CCBode) plot. A PSS4B stabilizer is viewed as two filters connected in series: a band-pass filter and a phase compensator. A space searching approach is used to tune the phase compensator which ensures that the phase frequency response of the PSS4B stabilizer is bounded within an acceptable limit; a CCBode plot then helps tune the magnitude frequency response of the band-pass filter so as to achieve a better stability performance over a wide range of frequency band.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Power Transformer Winding Vibration and Deformation under External Short-circuit Faults
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The transformer winding deformation and the insulation damage will occur under the impact of huge electromagnetic forces caused by the short circuit faults. In this paper, the electromagnetic-mechanical (E-M) field coupling 3D FE model was used for analyzing the transient characteristics of power transformer under short circuit faults. Considering the process of the transformer winding suffering short circuit current is a complicated multi-field coupling problem, this paper explores the inter-relationship between the short circuit fault topology, electromagnetic field and the mechanical field. Both the mathematical model of each field involved and the E-M field coupling model have been built. By the use of 3D FEM, the transient characteristics such as the electromagnetic forces, stress distribution and displacement of the transformer model have been calculated and simulated. Additionally, by analyzing the results from the simulation example, the radial and axial forces characteristics and the structure design suggestion for the winding have been obtained and proposed.

articleTitle: A Study on Daily Peak Electric Load Forecasting Using Radial Basis Function Netwrok
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The electric load forecasting is a challenging problem because variations of load might occur in an hour or a day period. These variations depend on many variables such as weather conditions, the day of the week, time of day, seasonal factors, social activities, and social economic factors. In this paper, we propose the load forecasting method based on the RBF neural network, which is an efficient technique for the daily peak load forecasting in Korea. The 2014-2016 dataset in Korea was employed to evaluate and validate the proposed approach. Obtained results were compared with the feed-forward network. The study showed that the proposed approach can be applied to forecast the daily peak electric load effectively.

articleTitle: Assessment method and suppression strategy of operational risk in long-term power market considering the large-scale renewable energy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: With the reform of power market and the large-scale grid connection of renewable energy, the operational risk assessment and risk suppression of the power market have received extensive attention. Taking the impact of renewable energy grid connection on the electricity market into account, this paper establishes an indicator system for the operational risk of the long-term electricity market, including electricity price fluctuation risk, power supply shortage risk, credit risk and system security risk, etc. Then based on the improved AHP and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, a comprehensive evaluation model is established to evaluate the operational risk of power market with renewable energy. Using test dataset, the proposed approach is applied to a case study to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model and its satisfactory impact on the risk assessment of the long-term power market. Lastly, this paper puts forward risk suppression measures from the aspects of decreasing market power and controlling credit risk.

articleTitle: Method for Single-phase Electric Meter Phase Discrimination Based on Multiple Linear Regression
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The phase information of single-phase electric meter is crucial to improve the level of load management and the quality of modeling. A method for single-phase electric meter phase discrimination based on multiple linear regression (MLR) is proposed. The MLR equation takes the single-phase electric meter voltage as the dependent variable. Meanwhile, it takes the gateway meter voltage, the gateway meter current and the single-phase electric meter current as the independent variables. Each single-phase meter forms a regression equation with the gateway meter A, B and C respectively. The determination coefficients of the three regression equations are calculated. According to the value of the coefficients, the phase of single-phase electric meter is discriminated. An example is given to analyze the proposed method with actual energy meter reading data. The analysis results show that the proposed method has higher accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Energy relative entropy fault section location based on matching pursuit method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of power supply and the accuracy of section location method, based on the characteristics of upstream and downstream transient zero mode currents at fault point, this paper proposes the fault section location method based on energy relative entropy of matching pursuit method. The characteristics of transient zero mode current are: the transient zero mode current of the adjacent detection point on the same side of the fault point has a high similarity; the transient zero mode current similarity of adjacent detection points on both sides of the fault point is low, and the initial polarity is opposite. The distribution automation terminal upload the fault data to the master station, and the master station adaptively decompose the fault signal by matching pursuit method, and calculate the relative entropy value between the adjacent detection points. By constructing a section location vector, the section corresponding to the largest element in the section location vector is the fault section. Several simulations are carried out under different fault conditions, which show the correctness and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Analysis of heating and electrical loads Based on Auto-encoder for Integrated park
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Industrial parks with manufacturing, service industries and comprehensive parks refer to large-scale comprehensive buildings with a certain industry as the main support. The integrated park will provide independent power supply and heating for its buildings. Through the analysis of the thermoelectric characteristics of the park users, the energy characteristics of the corresponding users and the entire park are obtained, which is of great significance to the economic operation of the park and energy conservation and emission reduction. This paper mainly uses auto-encoding and K-means technologies to analyze the heat load and power load of the park from two dimensions: user and category (cluster analysis results), and finally a real case is used to verify the method.

articleTitle: Research on Location Selection and Capacity Planning of Urban Electric Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) is a kind of mobile micro-grid. With the gradual increase of EV owners, the layout and planning of charging stations are gradually highlighted. Considering the travel habits of urban residents, the load distribution of electric vehicles is predicted by Monte Carlo sampling from the perspective of predicting users' travel routes. The AP algorithm is used to find the clustering center from multiple alternative locations and determine the optimal construction location of the charging station. This method fully considers the driving demand of electric vehicles and the actual situation of planning cities. Finally, an example is given to plan the charging station in the city, and good results are obtained from load forecasting to clustering out the charging station construction.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanisms and Benefits of Electrochemical Energy Storage Participating in Power System Peak Shaving
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Electrochemical energy storage is considered to be the best quality participant in the ancillary services market because its power and energy can respond quickly to demand. However, nowadays the trading mechanisms of the ancillary services market are mainly aimed at conventional generators which results in the lack of bidding and settlement mechanisms for energy storage participation in the ancillary services market. In this case, the trading mechanisms of energy storage participating in the peak shaving market is focused on in this paper. Based on the relationship between the charge-discharge depth and its life and the equivalent annual cost, this paper suggests that the energy storage quotation in peak shaving bidding should be various based on the charge-discharge depth zones. Besides, the one-part and two-part settlement methods in the peak shaving market are came up. According to the calculation of the investment cost and peak shaving benefit of electrochemical energy storage, charging and discharging price models suitable for energy storage to participate in peak shaving are proposed. The mentioned methods are verified by a specific case to analyze the cost-effectiveness of electrochemical energy storage in peak shaving.

articleTitle: Non-intrusive Load Decomposition of Stacked Hybrid Recurrent Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: Non-intrusive Load Decomposition (NILD) is the process of extracting the power consumptions multiple appliances from the total consumption signal of the building. For the problems of weak time characteristic, high misjudgment rate and low accuracy of load decomposition of traditional algorithm for multi-state equipment, this paper, based on deep learning, proposes a stacked hybrid recurrent neural networks (SHRNNs) method to decompose power load. Firstly, the NILD model of SHRNNs is constructed by combining gated recurrent unit neurons, long short-term memory neurons and convolution unit neurons, which often used to solve the time series problem. Then, based on the UK-DALE-2017 dataset, different input sequence lengths are set according to different electrical equipment, and the total load sequence is decomposed by using the built model. Finally, the validity of the model is verified by comparing with the traditional load decomposition algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Gas Protection Misoperation Mechanism and Strategy in Switching Process of On-Load Tap Changer for Large Capacity Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The arc generated when the on-load tap-changer (OLTC) is switched can cause the insulating oil inside the oil tank to surge. With the increase of transformer capacity, the oil surge is very severe due to the large arc current during the switching process, and the gas protection misoperation accident occurs frequently. This paper first analyzes the characteristics of the oil flow velocity in the connecting pipe of oil conservator when faults of different severity occur, and then compares it with the oil flow velocity characteristics in the case of normal switching of OLTC. Finally, according to the difference of flow characteristics in two cases, two strategies for dealing with gas protection misoperation are proposed. One is to reset the settings of the gas protection, and the other is the delay strategy.

articleTitle: Variable Droop Control for Wind Farm to Participate the System Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: This paper presents an adaptive frequency response control scheme for the large scale wind farm, which enables wind farm to participate the grid frequency regulation. The main advantage of this scheme is that, by adjusting the droop coefficient of each wind generator in response to its local wind speed, this scheme takes into account the wind speed difference among wind generators. Specifically, the droop coefficient of each wind generator is dynamically adjusted inversely proportionally to the local power margin, which is computed using the local wind speed. This way, the wind farm frequency support power is distributed among multiple wind generators in an adaptive and reasonable fashion. As a result, not only the wind farm frequency support performance is improved, but also the wind generator stability is ensured. Simulation results on the data collected from a real wind farm validate the effects of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on Typical Single-Phase High Resistance Grounding Fault Detection Methods in Resonant Grounding Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 8th International Conference on Advanced Power System Automation and Protection (APAP)
abstract: The problem of high resistance grounding fault detection in resonant grounding system is always the pain point and difficulty in the field of power system research. To solve the problem, based on PSCAD software, this paper firstly establishes a typical distribution system model, and analyzes the relationship between the transient component, traveling wave component and the fault initial angle, transition resistance value and arc. Secondly, this paper analyzes the effect of the main fault detection methods such as transient methods and travelling wave method, and gives the effective domain of different detection methods.
